news.title: Brent oil jumps more than 4% as U.S. reportedly sends third aircraft carrier to Middle East
news.description: Oil prices rose sharply Thursday, following a report the U.S. is sending a third aircraft-carrier strike group to the Middle East.

news.title: Trump Accounts have auto-enrolled more than 60 million children, Treasury says
news.description: More than 60 million children have been automatically enrolled in Trump Accounts, according to a Treasury Department announcement exclusively provided to CNBC.
